# Security Policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

Report vulnerabilities privately using GitHub Security > Report a vulnerability, if enabled, or contact the maintainer via GitHub profile. Do not post exploit details, credentials, or voice samples in public issues. See [security documentation](../docs/SECURITY.md). No guaranteed response window is offered.
